results.what: Personal correspondence drafts: a family letter and a report to a physician on a medical treatment. Biographical interest only.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely non-mathematical: letter drafts about family correspondence and a medical treatment. At most it has minor biographical value, such as evidence of illness and of sheets reused around the dissertation period.
transcription_corrections: 'Ew. Wohlgeboren' is correctly read; the second draft is addressed to a physician, not to a family member.
The insertion above 'angewandten ... mittels' reads 'Arznei' (Arzneimittels), consistent with the medical context; 'verordneten Mixtur(en)' is plausible.
'bis die Öffnung[?] ... erfolgte' refers to the effect of the remedy; the struck word is 'Montag', replaced by a reference to 'am 3. Morgens'.
'U. D. U. D.' is probably a set of abbreviated closing or signature formulas, not a mathematical expression.
Opening line: 'Lieber W.' (addressee abbreviated, possibly Wilhelm); 'Eltern' at the line end is uncertain.
'mit Gleichem vergeltest' (or 'vergiltst') is a plausible reading of the last line of the first letter.
